narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in central New Jersey on the afternoon of July 25. Rainfall amounts were as high as 1.5 to 2.5 inches.
ev: NJ Route 33 was closed due to flooding just to the east of NJ Route 34 in Wall Township.
NJ Route 71 was closed due to flooding at Warren Avenue in Spring Lake Heights.
NJ Route 66 was closed due to flooding just to the east of NJ Route 18 along the border between Ocean Township and Neptune Township.
